passphrase.conflict: The passphrase this device was using does not open what your other GLANCE apps keep on this account. That is why the household roster was empty here, and dayGLANCE could not read tasks sent from here. Enter the one the other apps use; what is on this device is kept and uploaded again under it.
passphrase.explain: Your things are encrypted here before they reach GLANCEvault, with a key made from this passphrase. Use the same passphrase as your other GLANCE apps on this account. If this is the account's first app, whatever you enter becomes its passphrase.
passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.neverSent: It is never sent anywhere and cannot be recovered. This device remembers the derived key, not the passphrase.

welcome.tagline: Know what is next for your things.

coverage.title: Warranties and coverage

welcome.footnote: Not a home inventory. No serial-number spreadsheets, no receipts to scan. Just the dates that matter and what they cost. Everything stays on this device unless you connect GLANCEvault.

empty.title: Nothing on the radar yet
empty.body: Add your first thing, a laptop, a phone, anything with a warranty, a plan or a shelf life, and thingGLANCE starts watching its dates for you.

headline.clear: All clear. Nothing needs you right now.

watching.sentence: You are watching {{things}} and {{plans}}. The next date is a way off.

queue.title: Needs a decision
queue.hint: Clear each one when you have decided, or hand it to dayGLANCE.
queue.emptyBody: When a warranty is about to lapse, a plan is about to renew or a device nears the end of its support, it shows up here.
queue.unassignedOne: This one falls to nobody in particular, so everyone is asked. The hand button makes one yours.
queue.unassignedAll: These fall to nobody in particular, so everyone is asked. The hand button makes one yours.
queue.unassignedSome_one: {{count}} of these fall to nobody in particular, so everyone is asked. The hand button makes one yours.
queue.unassignedSome_other: {{count}} of these fall to nobody in particular, so everyone is asked. The hand button makes one yours.

general.currencyHint: One currency for every amount. Nothing is converted.
general.webLookupLabel: Fill things in from the web
general.webLookupHint: Photo, specs and release date from Wikipedia; end of security updates from endoflife.date. Only the product name you type into the lookup box is sent, and only when you use it.
general.installHint: Runs in its own window, works offline, and shows a badge when something needs a decision.

vault.rosterRefused: Your vault is refusing the shared household roster: "glance-users" is not in its GLANCEVAULT_ALLOWED_APPS. Until it is added and the vault's container recreated, no GLANCE app can sync members through this vault, and each keeps only its own copy. Restart dayGLANCE and lastGLANCE afterwards: they stop trying until relaunched.
vault.tokenForbidden: That token cannot access this account.
vault.unreachable: Could not reach the vault. Check the URL, and that this site's address is in the server's allowed origins.
vault.appNotAllowed: Connected, but this server does not list "{{app}}" in its allowed apps yet. Add it to GLANCEVAULT_ALLOWED_APPS (keep the apps already listed), then recreate the vault's container: a plain restart keeps the old settings. The server's /healthz page shows the list in effect.
vault.reachFresh: Reachable. This account is new: your passphrase will set its encryption key.
vault.reachExisting: Reachable, and the account already has data. Use the same passphrase as your other GLANCE apps.
vault.rosterNotListed: {{reach}} One thing to fix on the server: it does not list "glance-users" in GLANCEVAULT_ALLOWED_APPS, so the household roster will not sync, here or in your other GLANCE apps.

live.on: Live: changes from your other devices arrive within seconds.
live.connecting: Connecting live updates. Until then it checks every few minutes.
live.stalled: Live updates are blocked, probably by a reverse proxy buffering /events. It still checks every few minutes.
live.unsupported: This vault server is too old for live updates. It checks every few minutes.
live.off: Checks every few minutes, and whenever you return to the app.

vault.rowsSkipped_one: {{count}} row could not be decrypted and was skipped.
vault.rowsSkipped_other: {{count}} rows could not be decrypted and were skipped.
vault.disconnectNote: Your things stay on this device and in the vault. Only the connection is removed.
vault.encryptedHint: Everything is encrypted on this device with a key made from your sync passphrase before it leaves. The vault stores ciphertext it cannot read. The passphrase is the same one your other GLANCE apps use on this account, and it is never sent anywhere.
vault.syncWithHint: thingGLANCE syncs one way only: through GLANCEvault, end-to-end encrypted. It also carries the shared household roster and tasks sent to dayGLANCE. Without it, everything stays on this device.
vault.proNote: GLANCEvault Pro, the hosted vault, is coming soon. If you were sent an account key as a tester, it works here today.
vault.accountKeyHint: Paste the key you were sent. It is exchanged once for this device's own credential and never stored.
vault.serverNeeds: The server needs <id>{{app}}</id> in GLANCEVAULT_ALLOWED_APPS, and this site's address ({{origin}}) in its allowed origins. Its /healthz page lists the apps it accepts.

household.wentToHousehold: Everything of theirs went to the household.
household.membersHint: Everyone the household tracks things for. A name is all it takes: a member does not need the app or a device. {{where}}
household.membersNotConnected: Not connected to GLANCEvault, so members stay on this device for now.
household.membersLocal: Members added here stay on this device for now.
household.membersShared: The same list dayGLANCE, lastGLANCE and lifeGLANCE use on this vault account.
household.stillTied_one: {{name}} still {{ties}}. Hand it to someone first.
household.stillTied_other: {{name}} still {{ties}}. Hand them to someone first.
household.hiddenMine_one: One of these is private to {{name}}, so only you can see it now.
household.hiddenMine_other: {{count}} of these are private to {{name}}, so only you can see them now.
household.hiddenOthers_one: One of these is private to {{name}}, so you cannot see it now.
household.hiddenOthers_other: {{count}} of these are private to {{name}}, so you cannot see them now.
household.becomesVisible_one: It becomes visible to the whole household.
household.becomesVisible_other: They become visible to the whole household.
household.noMembers: No members yet. Add yourself first.
household.pickYourself: Pick which member this device belongs to. It lets things be handed to you to deal with, and private items be yours.
household.needSecond: Owners, payers and the member filter show up once there is a second member.
household.otherDevicesHint: Detaching a device stops it counting as that person. It does not sign the device out of the vault.
household.goneMember: someone no longer on the list
household.rosterKeyConflict: This device was using a passphrase that does not match your other GLANCE apps, so it could not read the roster. Enter the right one and the members appear.
household.rosterLocked: The roster is read once you enter your sync passphrase.
household.rosterPaused: The roster could not be checked just now: sync with the vault is pausing after a failed request and will retry on its own.
household.rosterReading: Reading the roster from your vault…
household.rosterError: Could not read the roster from your vault at {{at}}: {{error}}
household.rosterRejected_one: Your vault has {{count}} roster row that could not be read as a member (checked at {{at}}).
household.rosterRejected_other: Your vault has {{count}} roster rows that could not be read as a member (checked at {{at}}).
household.rosterSkipped_one: {{count}} roster row in your vault could not be decrypted at {{at}}, which usually means a different passphrase.
household.rosterSkipped_other: {{count}} roster rows in your vault could not be decrypted at {{at}}, which usually means a different passphrase.
household.rosterEmpty: Checked your vault at {{at}} and found no members in the shared roster for this account.

integrations.passphraseBody: It makes the key that encrypts tasks sent between your GLANCE apps.
integrations.dayglanceHint: Turn anything in your queue into a dayGLANCE task with one tap. When you complete the task there, the item clears here, on every device.
integrations.sendReceiveHint: Uses GLANCE intents over your vault connection, end-to-end encrypted. dayGLANCE needs GLANCEvault intents turned on too.
integrations.otherSurfacesHint: Widgets, the menu bar popup, GLANCElauncher cards and MCP tools will all read one object: the glance snapshot. This is what it holds right now, including the reminders this device would get. Nothing schedules them yet: that arrives with the phone and desktop apps.

data.backupHint: A plain JSON file with everything except sample data. Importing merges by item, newest wins, so it never rolls anything back.
data.samplesHint: A realistic set of things and plans to explore with. Samples never sync; editing one turns it into a real item.
data.eraseHint: Deletes everything stored in this browser. Anything already in your vault stays there.

about.tagline: Know what is next for your things.
about.familyHint: dayGLANCE plans the day, lastGLANCE remembers when you last did something, lifeGLANCE holds the long view. thingGLANCE watches the things you own.
about.webData: Where the web data comes from
about.webDataHint: Product facts: Wikipedia (CC BY-SA). Support windows: endoflife.date (MIT). Dates marked as estimates are projections from a maker's usual support window, not promises.

householdFields.whoDealsHint: The person asked about its dates. Only members who use the app can be picked.

hides.thing: This hides the thing from the rest of the household; it is not separately encrypted.
hides.plan: This hides the plan from the rest of the household; it is not separately encrypted.
